conventions.units: units/<faction>_<unit>.png 64x64 RGBA, 1px faction outline baked in; units/src/*_128.png clean 128px sources
conventions.anchor: all sprites are bottom-centre anchored: draw at (x - w/2, y - h*0.96) for units, (x - w/2, y - h*0.97) for buildings
conventions.facing: Night Court sprites face down-right, Dawn Order sprites face down-left (they face each other across the map). Mirror with scaleX(-1) for the other direction.
conventions.ui: ui/*.png 64x64 RGBA icons; badge_level_N overlays; team_ring_<faction>.png 64x32 drawn under units
conventions.terrain: terrain/tile_<water|ford|grass|mud>.png 128px seamless (256px variants too); terrain/props/*.png 128px bottom-anchored
